scientific_limitation_statement: The current DS08 authoritative chips contain five spectral bands: B02, B03, B04, B11, B12. Band B08 (Near-Infrared, 842 nm) was not included in the original DS08 specification. Consequently, standard NDVI ((B08 - B04)/(B08 + B04)) cannot be calculated from the current raster. Any future vegetation-index requirement must be addressed in subsequent dataset acquisition designs.
